items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: if you didn't play like Wayne King, Guy Lombardo and this other band that played that kind of music

ctx.x: For instance, would you ever play gigs just for White people?

Yeah. Illinois. You stayed in Illinois...you'd go up there, and if you didn't play like Wayne King, Guy Lombardo and this other band that played that kind of music... [JAN GARBER] Your repertory had to sound like that on (?) . Sweet stuff.
What did the guys in the band feel about doing gigs like that?
